mapper.select: select member_id as memberId, phone, nickname, avatar, member_label as memberLabel, status, last_login_time as lastLoginTime, create_time as createTime, remark from dh_live_member where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'

select profile_id as profileId, member_id as memberId, gender, birthday, focus_tags_json as focusTagsJson, region, health_notes as healthNotes from dh_live_member_profile where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'

select setting_id as settingId, member_id as memberId, live_reminder_enabled as liveReminderEnabled, live_reminder_minutes as liveReminderMinutes, wifi_download_only as wifiDownloadOnly from dh_live_member_setting where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'

select account_id as accountId, member_id as memberId, current_points as currentPoints, total_earned as totalEarned, total_consumed as totalConsumed from dh_live_member_points_account where member_id = #{memberId}

select stat_id as statId, member_id as memberId, stat_date as statDate, study_seconds as studySeconds, completed_count as completedCount, quiz_count as quizCount, correct_count as correctCount, points_earned as pointsEarned, streak_days as streakDays from dh_live_member_daily_stat where member_id = #{memberId} order by stat_date desc limit 1
select count(1) from dh_live_reservation where member_id = #{memberId} and status in ('0', '2', '3')

select r.rec_id as id, r.scene, r.target_type as targetType, r.target_id as targetId, r.title_override as title, r.subtitle_override as subtitle, r.cover_override as cover, r.action_text as actionText, r.sort from dh_live_recommendation r where r.scene = #{scene} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and (r.online_time is null or r.online_time <= sysdate()) and (r.offline_time is null or r.offline_time > sysdate()) order by r.sort asc, r.rec_id desc
select live_id as id, biz_code as bizCode, title, status as statusCode from dh_live_session where live_id = #{liveId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into dh_live_reservation (member_id, live_id, reminder_time, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{liveId}, #{reminderTime}, #{status}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update reminder_time = values(reminder_time), status = values(status), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update dh_live_session set reservation_count = greatest(0, reservation_count + #{delta}), update_time = sysdate() where live_id = #{liveId}
mapper.insert: insert into dh_live_watch_record (member_id, live_id, watch_seconds, progress_percent, last_position_seconds, first_watch_time, last_watch_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{liveId}, #{watchSeconds}, #{progressPercent}, #{lastPositionSeconds}, sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update watch_seconds = greatest(watch_seconds, values(watch_seconds)), progress_percent = values(progress_percent), last_position_seconds = values(last_position_seconds), last_watch_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select c.course_id as id, c.biz_code as bizCode, c.topic_id as topicId, t.topic_name as topic, c.creator_id as creatorId, cr.creator_name as creator, c.title, c.summary, c.cover_image as coverImage, c.course_type as courseType, c.view_count as viewCount, if(f.favorite_id is null or f.status = '1', 0, 1) as favorite, p.progress_percent as progress from dh_live_course c left join dh_live_topic t on t.topic_id = c.topic_id left join dh_live_creator cr on cr.creator_id = c.creator_id left join dh_live_member_favorite f on f.target_type = 'course' and f.target_id = c.course_id and f.member_id = #{memberId} left join dh_live_learning_progress p on p.target_type = 'course' and p.target_id = c.course_id and p.member_id = #{memberId} where c.biz_code = #{bizCode} and c.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select ch.chapter_id as id, ch.course_id as courseId, ch.biz_code as bizCode, ch.title, ch.source_type as sourceType, ch.source_id as sourceId, ch.duration_seconds as durationSeconds, ch.sort, p.progress_percent as progress, case when p.status = '1' then 'complete' when p.progress_percent > 0 then 'current' else 'pending' end as status from dh_live_course_chapter ch left join dh_live_learning_progress p on p.target_type = 'chapter' and p.target_id = ch.chapter_id and p.member_id = #{memberId} where ch.course_id = #{courseId} and ch.publish_status = '1' and ch.del_flag = '0' order by ch.sort asc, ch.chapter_id asc

select c.content_id as id, c.biz_code as bizCode, c.topic_id as topicId, t.topic_code as topicCode, t.topic_name as topic, c.creator_id as creatorId, cr.creator_name as creator, cr.avatar as creatorAvatar, c.content_kind as kind, c.title, c.summary, c.body, c.cover_image as coverImage, c.video_url as videoUrl, c.duration_seconds as durationSeconds, c.read_time_minutes as readTimeMinutes, c.likes_count as likesCount, c.favorites_count as favoritesCount, c.comments_count as commentsCount, if(f.favorite_id is null or f.status = '1', 0, 1) as favorite, if(l.like_id is null or l.status = '1', 0, 1) as liked from dh_live_content c left join dh_live_topic t on t.topic_id = c.topic_id left join dh_live_creator cr on cr.creator_id = c.creator_id left join dh_live_member_favorite f on f.target_type = 'content' and f.target_id = c.content_id and f.member_id = #{memberId} left join dh_live_member_like l on l.target_type = 'content' and l.target_id = c.content_id and l.member_id = #{memberId} where c.biz_code = #{bizCode} and c.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select e.entry_id as id, e.biz_code as bizCode, e.category, e.title, e.description, e.tags_json as tagsJson, if(f.favorite_id is null or f.status = '1', 0, 1) as favorite from dh_live_encyclopedia e left join dh_live_member_favorite f on f.target_type = 'encyclopedia' and f.target_id = e.entry_id and f.member_id = #{memberId} where e.publish_status = '1' and e.del_flag = '0'
and e.category = #{category}
and e.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by e.sort asc, e.entry_id desc

select e.entry_id as id, e.biz_code as bizCode, e.category, e.title, e.description, e.body, e.tags_json as tagsJson, if(f.favorite_id is null or f.status = '1', 0, 1) as favorite from dh_live_encyclopedia e left join dh_live_member_favorite f on f.target_type = 'encyclopedia' and f.target_id = e.entry_id and f.member_id = #{memberId} where e.biz_code = #{bizCode} and e.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select q.question_id as id, q.biz_code as bizCode, q.topic_id as topicId, t.topic_name as topic, q.type, q.prompt, q.options_json as optionsJson, q.answer_key as answerId, q.explanation, a.selected_answer as selectedAnswer, a.is_correct as isCorrect, a.answer_time as answerTime from dh_live_quiz_question q left join dh_live_topic t on t.topic_id = q.topic_id left join dh_live_quiz_answer_record a on a.question_id = q.question_id and a.member_id = #{memberId} where q.publish_status = '1' and q.del_flag = '0' order by q.sort asc, q.question_id asc limit 1

select question_id as id, biz_code as bizCode, prompt, options_json as optionsJson, answer_key as answerId, explanation from dh_live_quiz_question where biz_code = #{bizCode} and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select record_id as id, member_id as memberId, question_id as questionId, selected_answer as selectedAnswer, is_correct as isCorrect, answer_time as answerTime, points_awarded as pointsAwarded from dh_live_quiz_answer_record where member_id = #{memberId} and question_id = #{questionId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dh_live_quiz_answer_record (member_id, question_id, selected_answer, is_correct, answer_time, points_awarded, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{questionId}, #{selectedAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, sysdate(), #{pointsAwarded}, sysdate(), sysdate())
insert ignore into dh_live_member_points_account (member_id, current_points, total_earned, total_consumed, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update dh_live_member_points_account set current_points = current_points + #{pointsChange}, total_earned = case when #{pointsChange} > 0 then total_earned + #{pointsChange} else total_earned end, total_consumed = case when #{pointsChange} < 0 then total_consumed - #{pointsChange} else total_consumed end, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: insert into dh_live_member_points_log (member_id, points_change, change_type, source_type, source_id, balance_after, description, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{pointsChange}, #{changeType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, (select current_points from dh_live_member_points_account where member_id = #{memberId}), #{description}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select log_id as id, member_id as memberId, points_change as pointsChange, balance_after as balanceAfter, create_time as createTime from dh_live_member_points_log where member_id = #{memberId} and source_type = 'daily_checkin' and date(create_time) = curdate() limit 1

select log_id as id, member_id as memberId, points_change as pointsChange, change_type as changeType, source_type as sourceType, source_id as sourceId, balance_after as balanceAfter, description, create_time as createTime from dh_live_member_points_log where member_id = #{memberId} order by create_time desc, log_id desc
mapper.update:
update dh_live_member
${key} = #{value},
update_time = sysdate()
where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into dh_live_member_profile (member_id,
${key} , create_time, update_time, del_flag) values (#{memberId},
#{value} , sysdate(), sysdate(), '0') on duplicate key update
${key} = #{value} , update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update:
update dh_live_member_setting
${key} = #{value},
update_time = sysdate()
where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'
